object.attr: stakeholder: an object ID names one object for good, because links on other branches, history, Compare and issued PDFs refer to it. Fixing ID reuse was decided on 2026-11-06 (open question Q7). Deleting an object leaves the number as it is, so a deleted object's ID isn't given out again.
object.description: When Mellon creates an object, Mellon shall set the document's next object number to one more than the new object's number.
